why: On the test bed both models gain from a higher peak rate than the 3e-4 that every full-size run so far used, and the stack gains more (learning_rate_with_data, seed 20001, 24,000 updates: from 3e-4 to 1.2e-3 the stack 1.54749 to 1.48638, the Transformer 1.49270 to 1.44423). Before two GPU windows go to a full-size pair at a new rate, complete 24,000-update runs at full size measure which rate is best there.

arms.fs-st3, fs-st6, fs-st12: v16's full-size stack with forgetting slopes (34,810,900 parameters; the recipe of p-forget, jobs gpu.sh with --read-forget) on windows of 512 bytes, at peak rates 3e-4, 6e-4 and 1.2e-3
arms.fs-tf3, fs-tf6, fs-tf12: the full-size Transformer (dim 512, 11 layers, 8 heads, 34,752,000 parameters, rotated Adam) on windows of 512 bytes, at the same rates

training: 24,000 updates of 8 windows of 512 bytes (98.3M training bytes), 1,000 warmup updates, cosine over 24,000, weight decay 0.05, weights averaged at 0.999, seed 20001, server GPUs (runner sched full.sh, code v17l)
measure: averaged weights on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams after 8,192 unscored lead bytes: the stack as a stream at its trained reach, the Transformer in windows holding 496 bytes of history with 16 scored; the bits of every piece kept
reading: A pilot without a pass mark. For each model its best of the three rates. If a model's best rate beats its own 3e-4 by at least 0.010, the next full-size pair (the knowledge-cell stack on streams of 2,048, as l2048-know-st, and the Transformer on windows of 2,048, as tf2048, 90,000 updates) trains at each model's best rate; otherwise at 3e-4. Recorded: the gap at each model's best rate against the gap at 3e-4, the change the higher rates make to it, and the stack's pulses per byte.
seen_before_recording: The test bed's learning_rate_with_data arms named above. At full size only 3e-4 has ever been trained: p-forget and tp reached 1.4597 and 1.4250 on the trainer's validation windows at 24,000 of 90,000 updates (a cosine over 90,000, not this pilot's schedule).
